description: Erection of a roof extension creating an additional storey to the house with conversion of garage to habitable room, extension to part of the boundary wall creating open air room to the rear and associated alterations. Replacement of windows with timber sash windows to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Revised Proposed Drawings (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) [received on 19 February 2019], and Planning Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Cover Letter and Existing Drawings (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) [received on 9 January 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
